note: Luminance and mask packs. Colour is never taken from these files; shaders multiply a token hue by the luminance.

sandDry.tool: Codex CLI built-in image_generation (GPT Image 2.0, ChatGPT plan seat); no API key
sandDry.prompt: Fine pale quartz sand of a Port Phillip Bay beach seen from directly above, even grain, with shallow wind ripples running diagonally across the whole frame at a regular pitch of about one tenth of the frame width, each ripple a soft ridge with a faint darker trough, sparse tiny crushed shell grit and a few flat shell fragments, a few dark mineral grains. Pale buff, low saturation, no pebbles larger than a grain of rice, no seaweed, no footprints.

sandWet.tool: Codex CLI built-in image_generation (GPT Image 2.0, ChatGPT plan seat); no API key
sandWet.prompt: Wet compacted sand of an ebbing foreshore seen from directly above: a smooth damp surface with faint swash lines curving across it, tiny drainage rills, sparse small shell fragments and worm casts, a few short dark fragments of dried seagrass, and a darker glossy-looking dampness with finer detail than dry sand. Mid grey-brown, low saturation, uniform tone across the frame, no standing water, no foam, no footprints.

pastureDry.tool: Codex CLI built-in image_generation (GPT Image 2.0, ChatGPT plan seat); no API key
pastureDry.prompt: Dry summer pasture of the Western District basalt plains seen from directly above: bleached straw-gold grass of mixed height with some matted lying stems, patches of exposed grey-brown clay soil showing through, small scattered basalt stones the size of a fist with a dark weathered skin, a few dry seed heads and clumps of tussock. Straw-gold to tan, low saturation, no green, no flowers, no tracks, even density.

strata.tool: Codex CLI built-in image_generation (GPT Image 2.0, ChatGPT plan seat); no API key
strata.prompt: A straight-on view of a weathered Miocene limestone sea cliff: pale cream to buff horizontal beds, each bed a different thickness from a hand to half the frame height, separated by recessed dark partings, with fine vertical joints, honeycomb pitting, small marl bands and faint orange iron staining from above. Salt-weathered, matte, even light, no vegetation, no sea, no sky. Left and right edges wrap seamlessly.

breaker.tool: Codex CLI built-in image_generation (GPT Image 2.0, ChatGPT plan seat); no API key
breaker.prompt: Sea foam seen from directly above on black: a dense band of breaking-wave lace across the whole frame, thick white ropes that split into tongues and holes, even density, pure white on pure black, no water colour, no sand, no perspective.

fleck.tool: Codex CLI built-in image_generation (GPT Image 2.0, ChatGPT plan seat); no API key
fleck.prompt: Sparse elongated white foam flecks on black seen from directly above, each a short streak three to six times longer than wide with a faint thinning tail, all aligned the same way, about forty across the frame, even density, pure white on pure black.

swash.tool: Codex CLI built-in image_generation (GPT Image 2.0, ChatGPT plan seat); no API key
swash.prompt: Thin stranded sea-foam lace on black seen from directly above: fine connected bubble threads forming open cells of mixed size, several broken curved lines running across the frame, even density, pure white on pure black.

channels.leafFine: R: leaf clusters, luminance mean 128 SD 34

foliage.origin: Made with SI image generation tools by the game's author (The Naturalist Atlas), per game-v2/public/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt section 4; the author's own work, no stock or purchased art. The pack re-arranges the four leaf clusters of that atlas over a wrapping canvas.

channels.mask: R: leaf-mass alpha of four cluster cards in 2 by 2 cells of 256 px (ragged outline, holes), inside a disc of 0.46 of the cell
channels.tone: G: cluster tone, mean 128 over the mass, the gap filled with the mean
channels.depth: B: blurred mask, deep inside a mass and small at its rim

crown.source: Pocket Reserve game-v2/public/assets/textures/civ7/leaf-broadleaf-albedo.jpg, leaf-broadleaf-alpha.jpg, leaf-hedgerow-albedo.jpg and leaf-hedgerow-alpha.jpg
crown.origin: Made with SI image generation tools by the game's author (The Naturalist Atlas), per game-v2/public/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt section 4; the author's own work, no stock or purchased art. The pack re-arranges the clusters of those atlases into four cards.

imageSeat.job: scripts/qa/taste/textures/codex-texture.sh jobs-w14t.txt (one Codex job, seven images, gpt-5.6-sol, built-in image_generation only)
imageSeat.returnedSize: 1254x1254 (originals kept; the job also wrote a 1024 resample with sips that the packs do not use)
imageSeat.register: AAA miniature-city strategy game in the visual register of Civilization VII ... Mid-value, low-saturation, narrow hue range, no strong colour accents, so it can be used as a grey detail layer. Exceptions: strata uses the straight-on cliff register; the three foam jobs use no register block.
imageSeat.tiling: overlap crossfade with variance-preserving weights (pack-lum.py overlap_tile); texture-post.py cross-fade measured ncc max 0.91 to 0.93 between 128 px crops and was not used for the packs
